s092: Is AVault free and open source?
s093: Yes. AVault is free to use and its source is public. The repository includes an MIT LICENSE file and GPL notices in source files; review the licensing notes before redistributing. You can inspect the code and contribute on GitHub.
s094: Do I need to root my phone?
s095: No. AVault uses Shizuku to access the system services needed for recording. You will need to start Shizuku and grant the required permissions during setup.
s096: Will it record every call on every phone?
s097: Recording support varies across manufacturers, Android versions and calling apps. Third-party call recording can be limited by the calling app itself. Make a test recording to confirm your configuration.
s098: What happens when I share a recording?
s099: Sharing an encrypted recording creates a decrypted audio copy for the app you select. That copy is outside the protection of your vault. Share only with a destination you trust.
s100: Can I choose how long recordings are kept?
s101: Yes. Enable auto-delete and choose a retention period in settings. Bookmarked recordings are excluded from automatic deletion. You can also leave auto-delete off.
